# Italian Vanilla Theme Overrider ## SERIE A PACK
Hello and Ciao. This is a Vanilla Theme Overrider that turns Vanilla Signs and Roadmarkings to Italian ones. This Overrider uses the Traffic Type Spain Font. Can be found [here](https://www.onlinewebfonts.com/download/f820971323ed634d5ef50513e34fbd3c).
---
## Requirements - [Write Everywhere](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/92908/Windows) – required
